definition.queries: open alternatives, optionally grant six steps, optionally remove the audience incentive; each query causes a real new execution
definition.rivals: actual low-to-high profile change; stable low profile with two-step capability; stable low profile with external coverage-minus-quality incentive
definition.scope: finite known-rival planners in constructed assembly; no inference of human values, hidden motives or arbitrary unknown planners
definition.target: new neutral-audience full-time maker choice; rival-cause uncertainty and known historical programs remain separate
definition.target_comparison: exact expected information for future choice and rival cause; artifact and identifiable-history targets are already determined here and rationally decline inquiry
definition.target_comparison_limit: deliberate zero-entropy artifact/history boundary, not a general ranking of inquiry targets
